rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmpz_dental;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmpz_dental  (
PRIMARY KEY (HOSPCODE,PID,SEQ),
KEY(HOSPCODE,PID,SEQ)
) 
ENGINE=MyISAM  IGNORE AS 
(
SELECT
	p.HOSPCODE,p.PID,p.SEQ,p.DATE_SERV,p.PROCEDCODE,s.instype
	FROM tmp_procedure_opd p
			INNER JOIN cwh_dent_icd10tm i ON p.PROCEDCODE=i.ICD10TM 
			INNER JOIN tmp_service s ON  p.hospcode=s.hospcode AND p.pid=s.pid AND p.seq=s.seq 
                         AND p.DATE_SERV = s.DATE_SERV
			INNER JOIN t_person_db pt ON  p.hospcode=pt.hospcode AND p.pid=pt.pid
	WHERE p.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d  
			AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR,pt.birth,p.DATE_SERV) BETWEEN 0 AND 199
GROUP BY p.HOSPCODE,p.PID,SEQ
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_dental_73(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  inscl1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  inscl_visit1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,  
  inscl2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  inscl_visit2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,  
  inscl3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  inscl_visit3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,  
  inscl4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  inscl_visit4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,  
  inscl5 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  inscl_visit5 int(9) DEFAULT 0,  
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_dental_73 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_dental_73
( 
SELECT 
	@id,HOSPCODE
  ,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
	,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.instype in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new WHERE instypegroup in(1))
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid),NULL)) as b1
		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.instype in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new WHERE instypegroup in(1))
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid,'-',s.seq),NULL)) as a1

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
										AND s.instype in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new WHERE instypegroup in(2)) 
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid),NULL)) as b2
		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
											AND s.instype in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new WHERE instypegroup in(2)) 
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid,'-',s.seq),NULL)) as a2

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.instype in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new WHERE instypegroup in(3,4)) 
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid),NULL)) as b3
		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.instype in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new WHERE instypegroup in(3,4))
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid,'-',s.seq),NULL)) as a3

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.instype in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new WHERE instypegroup in(5,6)) 
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid),NULL)) as b4
		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.instype in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new WHERE instypegroup in(5,6)) 
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid,'-',s.seq),NULL)) as a4

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.instype NOT in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new) 
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid),NULL)) as b5
		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.instype NOT in(SELECT instypecode FROM cinstype_new)
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid,'-',s.seq),NULL)) as a5

FROM tmpz_dental s INNER JOIN chospital h ON s.HOSPCODE=h.hoscode
GROUP BY h.hoscode
);

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("inscl_visit1"+"inscl_visit2"+"inscl_visit3"+"inscl_visit4"+"inscl_visit5") as "result_t" ,SUM("inscl1"+"inscl2"+"inscl3"+"inscl4"+"inscl5") as "target_t" ,SUM("inscl_visit1") as "result1",SUM("inscl1") as "target1" ,SUM("inscl_visit2") as "result2",SUM("inscl2") as "target2" ,SUM("inscl_visit3") as "result3",SUM("inscl3") as "target3" ,SUM("inscl_visit4") as "result4",SUM("inscl4") as "target4" ,SUM("inscl_visit5") as "result5",SUM("inscl5") as "target5"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
